text: Space, versatility, and a sought-after Queen Anne setting come together in this home near the conveniences of Queen Anne and Fremont. Come see this house today!

Introducing The Ashworth Collection by Brikat Homes, a boutique collection of just three thoughtfully designed new residences in the heart of Wallingford.The collection features one detached single-family residence offering up to 2,320 total sq.ft., including an oversized attached garage and ample storage, alongside two contemporary residences offering up to 1,885 total sq.ft., each with its own attached garage.Blending timeless architecture, quality craftsmanship, and curated finishes, each home features light-filled interiors, expansive windows, and open-concept living spaces. Gourmet kitchens showcase Bosch appliances, grout-less quartzite slabs, and a dry bar with wine cooler. Spa-inspired primary suites feature radiant-heated bathroom and shower floors. Energy-efficient AC and three distinctive finish packages add comfort and individuality.A signature highlight of all three residences is the private rooftop deck, offering unobstructed panoramic views of the Seattle cityscape, surrounding mountains, and sparkling waters. Perfect for entertaining or unwinding while enjoying the beauty of the Pacific Northwest.Just moments from Wallingford's beloved restaurants, boutique shops, parks, and everyday conveniences, The Ashworth Collection offers an exceptional balance of urban accessibility and neighborhood charm. Each residence is backed by a 2-10 Home Buyers Warranty for added peace of mind. All photos are of model home 3841B.

NEW ADJUSTED PRICE! Perched above the south shores of Lake Washington in the coveted Lakeridge community, this timeless mid-century home showcases breathtaking lake and Cascade Mountain views while offering the perfect blend of classic character and thoughtful updates. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace and six built-in surround sound speakers, creating an inviting space for relaxing or entertaining. The functional floor plan includes a private primary suite with a 3/4 bath, and all appliances stay, making this home move-in ready. The dining room opens through a large sliding glass door to an expansive wraparound deck, where you'll overlook stunning Lake Washington views and exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Crown molding throughout and custom built-in wall shelving add warmth and architectural charm. Major updates include a 50-year roof installed in 2019 and LeafGuard gutters for added peace of mind. Downstairs offers a one-car attached garage, washer and dryer, and a convenient laundry sink. Outside, the flat backyard provides space to garden, play, or unwind, with an existing French drain already in place. Conveniently located with easy access to Seattle, Renton, parks, and major commuting routes, this is a rare opportunity to own a well-maintained home with incredible views, timeless design, and endless potential.

This solid 1904 Craftsman home features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. It is located in the popular Minor neighborhood in Central Seattle. The lower level has it's own separate entrance to a wonderfully furnished one-bedroom ADU with a full bathroom. Property updates include: new siding, paint, windows, solar panels, front porch, back deck, & newly lined sewer pipe. Original charm is evident throughout to include: stately entry with period staircase, original doorknobs, pocket door in living room, fir floors on the main & upper level, 5 panel doors, & exposed beams. This well laid out, bright, and clean home has a wonderful downtown view which is especially beautiful at night. The home is largely turnkey and un-updated, it is ready for your personal upgrades without having to worry about major system upgrades or expensive repairs. The home is three levels and is situated on a 4,000 square ft lot, with a private backyard which is level and includes a newer deck. It is located on a tree lined street with sidewalks and landscaped roundabouts in one of Seattle's most vibrant and evolving neighborhoods. Living here you will be close to some of the city's best restaurants, coffee shops, parks, neighborhood favorites, and everything the Central District has to offer. Whether you're heading downtown, over to Capitol Hill, or simply enjoying the neighborhood, this is an ideal home location. Proximity to hospitals is another marked benefit along with the highly rated public schools.

Ask listing broker about builder preferred lender rates of 5.99%! Welcome to Cottages of Broadview - a collection of 4 newly released two story homes. Unit 123 features an architecturally designed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features a rare two car garage. Enter into a spacious living room with kitchen and dining: leading to a west facing backyard for lots of natural light. Half bath on main level for convenience. Second story features 10ft+ vaulted ceilings, with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Large primary suite with double sink vanity and rainfall shower head. Tall windows for natural light in every room, and ductless minisplits for year round energy efficient heating/cooling. Comes with 1 year builder warranty!

Opportunity awaits in this 1,770 sq. ft. Shoreline home, offered as-is and ready for its next chapter! Owned by the same family for nearly 40 years, this property offers a wonderful opportunity for buyers looking to update, personalize, and build equity. Major improvements include a newer roof, furnace, and hot water heater. The interior retains much of its original character, with vintage finishes and appliances that reflect a bygone era, complemented by a newer refrigerator. Bring your imagination and make this home your own! Conveniently located in the desirable Shoreline School District, within walking distance of Aurora Village shopping, dining, and transit, with easy access to I-5 and major commuter routes. Whether you're an investor, renovator, or buyer looking to create your dream home, this property offers outstanding potential in an established Shoreline neighborhood. Sold as-is; seller will make no repairs.

Enjoy panoramic views of Puget Sound & Olympics from this beautiful North Beach home ideally located on a quiet dead-end street in one of Seattle's most treasured neighborhoods. A timeless home with a whisper of Cape Cod, you'll love the rich mahogany, coved ceilings, white oak hardwoods, large windows, and gorgeous views at every turn. Prepare meals and entertain in a spacious granite kitchen which opens to adjoining sitting room, formal dining, and doors to incredible back patio and deck. Relax beside a romantic wood-burning fireplace in living room and watch the boats parade by in Puget Sound. Upstairs are 4 beds, all with views, including a primary suite with marble bath, walk-in closet, and private deck. Downstairs, discover a cozy rec room perfect for movie nights, a guest suite, flex space for hobbies, and potential for future MIL apt or AADU if desired. With multiple home office and WFH options, the versatile layout offers flexibility for today's lifestyle. Step outside and enjoy the saltwater air, dream patios and decks, outdoor gas fireplace, private yard, mature landscaping, oversized garage with shop space, and abundant off-street parking. Located within the geographic boundary to join North Beach Club for private beach access! Just minutes from the vibrant shops, restaurants, and amenities in Ballard yet wonderfully removed from the hustle and bustle. Welcome home!

Welcome to this storybook Bryant Tudor on a tree-lined street. This home keeps many of its original character-mahogany trim, coved ceilings, and mullions. As you enter you are welcomed by a spacious living room with batchelder fireplace and a dining room. The kitchen with granite countertops opens to a deck with views of Mt Rainier, an ideal place for entertaining. There are two bedrooms and a full bathroom on the main floor and 2 bedrooms with a 3/4 bath on the top floor. Have your morning coffee on the balcony off the bedroom with views of Mt Rainier and hints of Lake Washington. Spacious basement is ideal for guests, extra living space and storage. With one car garage and an extra off street parking, new carpet, fresh paint and updated electrical and plumbing, this home has it all. Close to Burke Gillman Trail, UW, Childrens, U Village and SR-520. Welcome to your new home.

HUGE Price Drop for quick sale!! Welcome to this beautifully updated Maple Leaf home where major improvements (over $55K) thoughtful design & an exceptional location come together! The stylish kitchen shines with quartz counters, Cafe 5-burner induction cooktop, Bosch dishwasher, dual convection ovens, artisan tile backsplash, coffee bar/wine storage, generous pantry & charming checkerboard floors. Access the deck with cedar railings, overlooking the private fenced backyard. Enjoy year-round comfort with a BRAND-NEW roof, NEW high-efficiency furnace with A/C, tankless water heater, updated plumbing & 6 new Milgard fiberglass windows. Fresh interior paint, updated LED lighting, custom blinds & beautifully refreshed baths with quartz vanities & LED mirrors add to the move-in-ready appeal. Downstairs daylight basement has open layout, utility room and 4th bedroom plus separate entrance that flows out to the backyard. Wired for a hot tub or sauna. New concrete driveway accommodates up to 4 cars, plus alley access, and new retaining wall. Just minutes to Green Lake & Maple Leaf Reservoir Park, with restaurants, coffee, breweries, PCC & Whole Foods nearby. Take the Roosevelt light rail to Downtown, sporting events, University of Washington, Childrens Hospital, & Sea-Tac Airport. Parks, pickleball, neighborhood events, dining & recreation are all close by. I-5 access just down the street. An ideal combination of city convenience and neighborhood living!

Bring your vision and unlock the potential of this split-level home on a spacious 16,139 SF lot! Tucked away at the end of a private street, this property offers a rare opportunity to create the home you've always wanted. The 1,250 SF upper level is functional and ready for your personal updates, while the unfinished lower level (1250SF) provides a blank canvas for additional living space, a recreation room, home office, or guest quarters. Major improvements include a newer roof (2 years old), HVAC and water heater (2014). Brand New Septic System too! All appliances stay, and the oversized carport offers the potential to be enclosed for additional garage or workshop space. Relax on the back deck and enjoy watching the planes arrive and depart from SeaTac airport. Conveniently located with endless possibilities for investors, DIY enthusiasts, or buyers looking to build equity. Home is being sold as is. Hardwood Floors. Double w/ Double Pain in/out pain windows. Buyer to verify al information to their own satisfaction.

IMPORTANT: This block of 35th Ave NE is a quiet street and NOT an arterial. Don't settle for a detached condo when you can own a true single family home on its own lot. Stylishly refreshed and move-in-ready 3 bedroom mid-century modern rambler located in Seattle's Cedar Park neighborhood. Brand new kitchen with flat-panel oak grain cabinets, quartz countertops, custom tile work and stainless steel appliances. Brand new designer bathroom. Brand new hard surface flooring throughout. Fresh paint. Updated building envelope with new siding. Spacious driveway with room for RV parking and carport with standalone storage room. Easy access to Lake Washington, freeways, Northgate and Downtown Seattle. Buyer to verify potential to build ADU/DADU(s) in the backyard. Ask us about financing incentives with preferred lender Specialty Home Loans.

Packed with character, natural light & untapped potential in an incredibly convenient location between Wallingford, Green Lake & the U District! Set up above the street and fully fenced, the home offers a surprising sense of privacy and separation while keeping you close to everything. The main level features beautiful hardwood floors, a spacious living room with fireplace, oversized dining room wrapped in windows, 2 bedrooms, full bath & a sunny bonus office/flex space. Beyond the finished living area, an unfinished basement plus a large usable unfinished attic offer tons of additional space for storage, hobbies, workspace or future expansion. Outside, enjoy a private fully fenced backyard with patio space and room to make it your own. Ample street parking makes coming and going easy, with UW, Green Lake, shops, restaurants & transit just minutes away, plus exceptionally easy freeway access and a quick commute downtown. Permitted parking adds ease and convenience. A classic Seattle home with loads of potential in a location that puts so much of the city within easy reach!

Exceptional opportunity to enjoy a lifestyle of entertaining, recreation, and Puget Sound access. The main level features a spacious gathering area with a large island flowing seamlessly into the living area anchored by a cozy wood fireplace. Large windows provide an abundance of natural light into the kitchen. Upstairs, the private primary suite offers a relaxing ensuite. The lower level adds so much versatility with a second kitchen that offers flexibility for guests, extended living, or potential in-law accommodations or even an ADU. This lower level also provides walk out access to the back yard that has a fully enclosed and heated in-ground (9 ft deep) pool complete with diving board and plenty of space to lounge, making summer days and gatherings effortless. The back yard features a (600 square feet) detached garage that provides plenty of space for a workshop, office space, home gym, hobby space or even a detached accessory dwelling unit (DADU). There is ample parking under an extra large carport and also plenty of room for an RV. Lot A Beach rights to The Cove convey with the purchase, providing access to 18 acres of private Puget Sound waterfront, 700 feet of beach, a community clubhouse, tennis/pickle ball courts, swimming pool and more. All appliances stay. Easy access to SR-509, I-5, Seattle, Tacoma, SeaTac Airport, Southcenter, and the Des Moines Waterfront. No HOA! Don't miss the opportunity to make this inviting home your own!

address: 4425 Fremont Ave N Unit C, Seattle, WA
text: Welcome to 4425 Fremont Ave N, where elevated design meets the energy of one of Seattle's most beloved neighborhoods. Set in the heart of Fremont, this home puts you just moments from the places that make the area feel alive: award-winning sandwich shops, fresh bagels, local coffee, destination restaurants, neighborhood pubs, boutique shopping, parks, and the Burke-Gilman Trail. Start the morning with coffee nearby, grab a bagel on the way to the trail, meet friends for lunch in downtown Fremont, then come home to skyline views that stretch from Seattle to Bellevue. Inside, the home is designed to feel polished, comfortable, and easy to live in. Engineered hardwood floors add warmth and durability, heated floors bring everyday luxury, and ductless mini splits provide efficient heating and cooling year-round. The Bosch professional appliance package gives the kitchen a refined, high-performance feel, while the thoughtful layout makes the home equally suited for quiet nights in or entertaining before a night out. Minutes from Downtown Seattle, South Lake Union, Queen Anne, Wallingford, Ballard, and quick Eastside connections, this location offers true urban convenience without losing the character that makes Fremont so special. With sweeping skyline views, elevated finishes, and an unbeatable neighborhood lifestyle right outside your door, this is Seattle living at its best.

address: 5847 NE 75th St Unit A105, Seattle, WA
text: Effortless living in an unbeatable Seattle location. This inviting condo offers the convenience of your own reserved parking space right outside your front door. No elevators, long hallways, or stairs-just park and your home! A charming private front porch welcomes you, complete with your own storage closet. Move-in ready. Enjoy a spacious, light-filled living room with bay window, cozy fireplace, and room for a good-size desk. Open kitchen and dining. A generous bedroom with ample closet space. A must have - washer/dryer in unit. New carpet. Exceptional location! The Burke-Gilman Trail is in your backyard, and Magnuson Park is just across the street, offering beaches, trails, off-leash dog park, boating, paddle boarding, and more! Minutes to UW, Seattle Children's Hospital, and University Village shopping and dining. Pet-friendly community, reserved parking, extra storage, and no rental cap add flexibility and value. Secure mail room steps away. Location, convenience, and lifestyle-this home delivers! Apply for membership at the View Ridge pool & tennis club, a beautiful facility, just a block north of the building. Come tour and discover why this is such a special opportunity. Love where you live!
